description: Which parts of Ontario Regulation 406/19 apply to a soil removal project or a reuse site, and the records to keep, based on soil volume, past land use and where the soil is going. Every parameter is optional and has a default. General information on the regulation, not legal or environmental advice. A qualified person under Ontario Regulation 153/04 prepares the assessments and reports, and the Soil Rules and the Registry forms set the detail. Confirm with your qualified person or the Ministry.

destination.description: Where the soil is going: reuse_site, class1 (a soil bank storage or soil processing site), landfill (a landfilling site or dump) or unknown.

enhanced.description: Is any part of the project area, or has it ever been, used for an industrial use, as a garage, as a bulk liquid dispensing facility including a gasoline outlet, or for dry cleaning equipment?

infrastructure.description: Is the reuse site part of an undertaking related to an infrastructure project?

instrument.description: Is the reuse site governed by a site-specific instrument such as a municipal fill permit, a by-law, an Aggregate Resources Act licence or a Planning Act approval?

known_discharge.description: Is any part of the project area known to be affected by the discharge of a contaminant?

land_use.description: Use of the whole project area as defined in Ontario Regulation 153/04: res_park_inst (residential, parkland or institutional, or a mix), agri_other (agricultural or other) or other (anything else, such as commercial).

pca.description: Has an assessment of past uses or a phase one environmental site assessment identified a potentially contaminating activity?

remediation.description: Is the primary purpose of the project to remediate contaminated land?

reuse_land_use.description: If the soil is going to a reuse site: is that site an agricultural or other use (agri_other) under Ontario Regulation 153/04, or something else (other)?

role.description: project_leader (the person responsible for the project that excavates the soil) or reuse_site (the owner or operator receiving excess soil).

settlement.description: Is any part of the project area in an area of settlement under the Planning Act?

urgent.description: Is the soil being excavated because of danger to health or safety, serious risk to the natural environment or to property, an order of an authority, or to maintain infrastructure in a fit state of repair?

volume.description: Cubic metres of soil to be removed from the project area (project_leader) or expected to be deposited for final placement at the reuse site (reuse_site). Unit: m3.

name: excess_soil_tracker_and_reuse_site_checker
title: Excess Soil Rules and Record-Keeping Checker
